title: Acme Fit: store listing
subtitle: The 3.0 listing on Google Play and the App Store, in English and Spanish, for watch, phone and tablet, with a custom page, two A/B tests and ads.

state.label: phone UI captured; tablet and watch mock-up

tldr: Check each platform page in en-US and es-ES: the text against its counters, the shots per device, and the shared icon and feature graphic. Then check the Runners page, the two B treatments, the store preview and the ads.

sections.title: Brief
sections.lead: Acme Fit 3.0 leads with the week view: one glance shows steps, workouts and the streak.

blocks.md: Runners and riders who track a week, not a day. Every first shot carries one benefit in a few words; the Spanish strings came from machine translation and wait for review.

sections.title: Listing
sections.lead: Both stores at the store maximums, in en-US and es-ES: 10 shots per App Store set, 8 per Play set, a feature graphic and the icon.

play.name: Acme Fit: Run, Ride, Rest
play.short: See your week of runs, rides and sleep in one glance. Keep the streak going.
play.full:
Acme Fit shows your week at a glance: steps, workouts, heart rate and sleep in one view.

Plan runs and rides, follow them on your watch, and keep your streak going with gentle reminders.

Planifica carreras y rutas en bici, síguelas en tu reloj y mantén la racha con recordatorios suaves.
